purpose: Real-time classification of only previously unclassified configurations in the user's selected 100 environments
source_snapshot_method: git archive of the recorded revision: AGENTS.md, pyproject.toml, benchmark environments, shared_scripts, shared_runtime app/server/verifier_helpers.py, incubator_solvers, realtime.py, and binding controllability/design docs. No Git worktree. Historical audits and dashboard annotations are excluded.
skip_rule: Skip every selected environment/difficulty/interaction key with a Boolean classification in the historical authoritative matrix. Skipping preserves historical evidence; it does not revalidate it against today's source.

review.provider_transport: Existing Codex built-in transport; request limits not independently asserted. This is source review, not a gameplay evaluation protocol.
review.scope: Classifications only. No puzzle, difficulty, interaction, clock-setting, or historical-label changes.

review_wrapper_template: Perform one independent real-time classification using the frozen prompt {prompt_path}. Read it fully and follow it. Substitutions: SOURCE_ROOT={source_root}; CASE_INDEX={case_index}; public_environment_name={public_name}; environment_id={environment_id}; difficulty={difficulty}; interaction_mode={interaction_mode}; OUTPUT_PATH={output_path}. Read the complete relevant source for this exact configuration. Write only the assigned JSON report with apply_patch. Do not inspect the audit manifest, prior classifications, other reports, or previous conversations. No source edits, browser/desktop access, external services, or nested agents. The user authorized this source-review report; concurrent reports are expected. This is not a computer-use benchmark evaluation.
ordering: environment_id lexicographic, difficulty ascending, full then simplified
